results.title: Harbour Hall - Venue Hire and Bookings
results.description: Book Harbour Hall for events, workshops and open days. Call the front desk on 555-0147 or use the enquiry form on this page to check availability and request a booking.

results.title: Harbour Hall Contact Us
results.description: Phone 555-0147, opening hours Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. Venue enquiries are handled by the events office; general mail goes through the contact form.

results.title: Harbour Hall Events Office - Enquiry Form
results.description: Online form for venue hire requests. Include preferred dates, expected number of guests and any equipment needs, and the team will reply within two working days.

results.title: Hire Harbour Hall for Community and Studio Events
results.description: Rates, floor plans and availability for hall hire, with a note that spring weekend dates fill early and bookings should be made well in advance.
